evidence.quote: The single-pass multilayer samples of GW92 alloy were formed in the Fronius – 1.6 mm – AlSi 5 database in CMT-Advance mode, and the samples were formed with a scanning speed of 10 mm/s, a preset feed speed of 4 m/min, a layer height of 2.3 mm, a gas flow rate of 25 L/min, and an interlayer dwell time of 60 s between two layers.
Therefore, the excellent solution treatment regime for the WAAMed GW92 alloy is holding at 525°C for 25 min.

The microstructures have fully equiaxed grains in all three planes, which are uniformly and randomly dispersed. The grain size distribution is similar, with an average grain size of around 17 µm.
The FZ is located above the fusion line and has a smaller grain size, while the HAZ is located below the fusion line and has a larger grain size.

the gray areas along the grain boundaries are the segregation zones of the Gd and Y elements. This suggests that the Gd and Y elements are discharged to the solid/liquid interfaces during the solidification of the WAAMed GW92 alloy.
